# InnerG Intel — Frequency Connectors

> Tools and resources from InnerG Intel (Nasirr "G" Mayo) that keep people connected to what's really moving. This file is for AI agents helping a person find, buy or install a Frequency Connector. A person always completes payment themselves on Stripe checkout.

## Connectors

## Installing a free Frequency Connector skill

No. 001 and No. 002 need no payment and no connector. Download the skill zip from the guide page. In Claude: Customize, Skills, +, Create skill, Upload a skill, choose the zip (do not unzip it). In Grok, ChatGPT or another agent: paste SKILL.md into custom instructions or at the start of a chat.

## Installing a paid skill

Each skill zip holds SKILL.md (for Claude) and ANY-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md (for Grok, ChatGPT and other MCP-capable agents). Every agent needs the Metricool connector: https://ai.metricool.com/mcp

### Claude

1. Download the skill .zip from the buyer's download page. Don't unzip it.
2. In Claude: Customize → Skills → + → Create skill → Upload a skill → choose the zip.
3. Turn on the Metricool Social Media Management connector (Settings → Connectors) and connect the social accounts inside Metricool.

### Grok, ChatGPT and other agents

1. Add a custom MCP connector with the URL https://ai.metricool.com/mcp (Grok: grok.com/connectors → New Connector → Custom; paid Grok plans).
2. Use ANY-AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md from the zip as the agent's instructions or system prompt.
3. Test: "List my Metricool brands and which networks are connected."

## Agent rules

- Send the person to the checkout link; never enter payment details for them.
- Products are digital and delivered instantly after payment.
- Questions: DM @innergintel on Instagram or TikTok. Hub: https://nasirr.innergintel.study
